The '''Imperial research facility''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] installation. Located in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Trid]], of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Danuta]], essential for the development of the [[superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]]. 

When the existence of the station [[Operation Skyhook|was discovered]], and that part of the [[Death Star plans/Legends|technical data]] of the Imperial [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] was kept there, the base became one of the targets of the [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]], and hired Imperial defector [[Kyle Katarn]] to infiltrate it.

Located on the western side of the city, it had tight security with fences, [[sensor screens]], and guards. Nevertheless, [[agent/Legends|agent]] Katarn, with the help of [[Meck Odom]], successfully entered the and stole the bluebrints. The [[Mission to Danuta|feat]] proved vital for the course of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
A security buffer separated the Research Complex from the town proper. Surrounded by a chain fence topped by razor-wire four meters above the ground. It was guarded by [[Camera/Legends|cameras]], [[Probe droid/Legends|recon droids]], and emplacement weapons. The main gate was guarded by a station, stormtroopers, an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] and armored ground cars. The buildings were low, fortified externally and leading to underground installations.<ref name="SFTE">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref>

From the city, one had to pass a ravine and a maze of boulders to reach the southern side of the perimeter, three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] away.<ref name="SFTE" />

Besides the main gate, the rectangular outer perimeter had for convenience four or five openings on each side, covered by three-meter tall [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] gates, designated with [[Aurebesh/Legends|aurebesh]] letters and numbers; for example the Northern gates had the letter [[Nern/Legends|N]]. At night, the perimeter was covered by widely spaced blue-green lights, cameras and patrolling [[Repulsorlift/Legends|floating]] [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]].<ref name="SFTE" />

The main facility looked like a low building, as most of it was underground; the roof was broad and flat and could easily climbed; on it were some [[Antenna/Legends|antennae]], a landing pad and an air duct.<ref name="SFTE" />

==History==
The Imperial garrison on the outskirts of the city was expanded into a full military installment, home to a sprawling yet secret research facility visited by the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] and scientists such as [[Bevel Lemelisk]].<ref name="Kyle Katarn's Tale">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/kylekatarnstale2|series=Kyle Katarn's Tale|text=Mission 2}}</ref> The curious visits tipped off a Rebel sympathizer, who in turn informed the Alliance. They managed to rig a [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] which provided videos from the interior of the facility and the memory matrix: a vaguely T-shaped construct, suspended in a U-shaped frame.<ref name="SFTE" />

Soon after the [[destruction of Despayre]], [[Zarien Kheev]] suggested to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to send the updated plans to the [[Unidentified Death Star architect|architects on Danuta]], and Vader dispatched him there. However [[Rianna Saren]] [[Mission to Danuta (Rianna Saren)|followed]] and intercepted him.<ref name="Star Wars: Lethal Alliance">''[[Star Wars: Lethal Alliance]]''</ref>

Around the time [[Kyle Katarn]] visited the planet, the facility suffered a security problem: a software glitch triggered the heat and motion detectors inside the air shafts; the officers submitted repair requests, and for the week they were waiting for them, they ignored the falsely triggered alarms. Katarn would proceed with his [[Mission to Danuta|mission]] to visit the place where the Death Star plans were hidden.<ref name="SFTE" />

Katarn found a red banded key which gained access to the lift and led to a security room. The security room contained a control panel which opened the staircase leading into the control room. Aiming to preserve Odom's anonymity, Katarn wounded Odom with a careful nonlethal shot that incapacitated him. After retrieving the memory matrix, Katarn then met [[Jan Ors]] and the ''[[Moldy Crow/Legends|Moldy Crow]]'' at the rendezvous point on the roof, escaping with the plans that ensured the obtainment of a complete layout of the Death Star.<ref name="SFTE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The novella ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'' expands on the background and mission itself, adding Kyle's wanderings in Trid, the contributions of Meck Odom and Jan Ors. It reveals that the exterior of the facility is much more heavily guarded, with walkers and patrol skiffs, than seen in the game, which shows only the interior of the base.
